scenes.narration: RAM chip prices nearly quadrupled in three months. The reason? Memory that doesn't exist yet.
OpenAI signed letters with Samsung and SK Hynix for up to nine hundred thousand memory wafers a month. Analysts say that's up to forty percent of the world's supply.
And the chip maker? Nvidia put thirty billion dollars into OpenAI, a company that runs on its chips.
It's like I pay you a thousand dollars, you spend it on my flowers, and I tell the bank my shop is worth a billion.
And the math? Bain says AI needs two trillion dollars a year in revenue by 2030. It's on track to fall eight hundred billion short.
If the boom is real, RAM stays expensive. If it's a bubble, prices could crash.
In this whole chain, only one thing is real. Your investment in RAM, if you have one. Follow for more.
